title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Office worker and gamer Sato Takahiro wakes up in a universe like his favorite space-shooter game, piloting a top-spec ship. He plans to earn money as a mercenary and retire to a house on a cozy planet, but takes in a young woman with heavy debts and gathers an all-female crew. The story mixes space battles with pirates and a growing harem.
life_message: Freedom means earning your own way with skill and building a comfortable home and household on your own terms.
